profile:
COMPANY NAME: Altivera (formerly Zynex Medical)
INDUSTRY: Medical Technology / Rehabilitation & Orthopedic Devices
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: Innovative, non-invasive medical technologies including electrotherapy, hot/cold compression, and bracing/traction systems designed to help patients manage pain, restore mobility, and accelerate recovery.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Healthcare providers, rehabilitation clinics, and patients undergoing physical therapy or recovery from injury/surgery.
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise / B2B (Sales to healthcare providers and clinics)
KEY FEATURES:
- Electrotherapy devices for pain relief and muscle re-education
- Hot/Cold compression therapy for inflammation reduction and healing
- Orthopedic bracing and traction systems for joint stabilization
- Patient Portal for managing therapy supplies and care team communication
- Clinic Store for ordering provider-recommended therapy products
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: Clinically proven, non-invasive solutions; backed by decades of experience; patient-centered design focused on real-world use and functional recovery between clinical visits.
TONE & POSITIONING: Professional, clinical, and patient-centric; positioned as a reliable, high-quality partner for healthcare providers and patients seeking advanced recovery solutions.
